title: UAE nominates Lana Nusseibeh for UN secretary-general
gist: Short audio brief: UAE nominates Lana Nusseibeh for UN secretary-general; the blurb also notes Iran's IRGC said seven vessels were hit in the Gulf and the US ordered some embassy staff to leave Saudi Arabia. Only a brief description is available.

insights.claim: The UAE has nominated Lana Nusseibeh for UN secretary-general.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: Iran's IRGC said seven vessels were hit in the Gulf.

insights.so_what: Continued attacks on Gulf shipping support a maritime-risk premium.
